create.name: Joe Reilly
create.bio:
Joe Reilly is a dharma teacher in the Plum Village tradition of Thich Nhat Hanh, and a singer-songwriter and social worker, and lives in Detroit. A student of Thich Nhat Hanh since 2004, he was ordained into the Order of Interbeing in 2011 with the dharma name True Ocean of Grace, and in 2021 received the Lamp Transmission at Deer Park Monastery in California, which authorised him to teach. Brought up Catholic in Kalamazoo, with Cherokee, Choctaw, Italian and Irish roots, he has a practice that draws together engaged Buddhism, progressive Catholicism and Native American spirituality. He belongs to the teaching community of the Lotus Institute with Larry Ward, Peggy Rowe Ward and Kaira Jewel Lingo as mentors.

In Detroit he shares the leadership of the Building Beloved Community Sangha, a group centred on Black, Indigenous and people of colour that meets on Zoom on Sunday evenings and Monday mornings, walks together on Belle Isle and holds a regular meditation evening at his home. He also travels to lead days of mindfulness and retreats, and mentors people who want to start or steady a practice. Music runs through all of it: he has made ten albums, four of them for children, and often sings on retreats, including his own settings of Plum Village practices such as the pebble meditation.

courses.title: Dharma Teaching and Mentoring
courses.description: He can be booked to lead mindfulness and meditation practice in the Thich Nhat Hanh tradition for groups and retreats, usually with his own songs woven in. He also mentors individuals who are beginning a practice or preparing to receive the Fourteen Mindfulness Trainings.

free_resources.title: Mother Earth Guided Relaxation
free_resources.description: A free 28-minute version of the Plum Village deep relaxation, guided with voice, bell and guitar, moving through the breath and a body scan towards rest and a sense of kinship with the earth.

free_resources.title: Building Beloved Community Sangha
free_resources.description: The Detroit sangha he co-leads: free sitting meditation and dharma sharing on Zoom on Sunday evenings and Monday mornings, a monthly hybrid session in the city, walking meditation on Belle Isle and a twice-monthly sitting for BIPOC practitioners. Donations are welcome.

free_resources.title: Dharma Songs for Connection with Joe Reilly
free_resources.description: A 55-minute episode of the Opening Dharma Access podcast in which he talks about his path in the Plum Village tradition and shares some of the practice songs he has written. Free to stream.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @JoeReillyMusic about 1.61k subscribers (channel header, 3 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 355 followers (profile page, 3 Nov 2026); Instagram @joereillymusic and Facebook not readable without logging in → ~2k readable → local_hero
flags: Much of his public output is music (ten albums, children's concerts, a band, The Community Gardeners), and his YouTube channel is music only, so no videos are listed; he is included as an ordained Plum Village dharma teacher, but a human may judge the listing too music-led or too thin (four items).
His Insight Timer profile is under his dharma name (insighttimer.com/oceanofgrace, 'True Ocean of Grace'); most of its tracks are songs, only one is a spoken guided practice.
Insight Timer location reads Detroit, MI; his own dharma page says he lives in Waawiyatanong/Detroit.
The email trueoceanofgrace@gmail.com is the one his dharma page links for teaching, mentoring and the sangha.
The Building Beloved Community Sangha is a group he co-leads, not his own brand; its site is used as a free resource.
The Lotus Institute (his teaching community) is not a Spiritpedia listing; no current Lotus programme names him.
left_out: Thich Nhat Hanh's Pebble Meditation (Insight Timer, 9.1k plays): its page describes the song as helping with fear or anxiety; left out as borderline under the health rule.
Other Insight Timer tracks and all YouTube videos: songs or concert recordings (music only).
The Other Shore book study (Sundays 4 Oct to 8 Nov 2026): already started.
Walking meditation on Belle Isle, 1 Nov 2026: past.
Books: none authored by him found; albums are not books.
